name: Select
summary: A native select, customisable where the engine supports it.

guidance.useFor: Choosing one option from a long, familiar list: country, state, month.
insteadUse: Few options people should compare: Radio group
Free text with suggestions: a text field
content: Default to the most likely option only when it's safe; otherwise ask people to choose

rungReason: <select> provides the role, the picker, keyboard selection, form participation and validation. Customisable select only restyles it.

control.note: Inside a Field: id, aria-describedby and aria-invalid as for TextInput

option.content: text only in v1 (no <selectedcontent>, no rich content)

chevron.position: after the select, at the inline end

keyboard.action: Native: choose without opening where the platform does (varies by OS)

keyboard.where: customisable select in Chromium (not WebKit, which follows macOS; checked 2026-10-24, WebKit 27.2)

keyboard.action: Choose the option, close, return focus to the select

focus.indicator: :focus-visible outline on the select; options show it inside the picker

react.props: every <select> prop; renders the wrap and chevron; Field context as TextInput
react.rule: v1 renders text options only - no <selectedcontent> (hydration risk, RFC-0001 §5)

enhancements.fallback: The native picker with the styled closed control

contrast: Increased contrast and reduced transparency: an opaque picker with a strong boundary
forcedColors: Field / FieldText; invalid → 2 px boundary; the picker uses Canvas / CanvasText, the chosen option SelectedItem
